description:
The development team at Acme Corp has deployed an internal application that runs on port 3001 on this server. You need to configure the 'acmecorp.test' virtual server in Virtualmin so that HTTP requests to the URL path '/app' are reverse-proxied to this backend application at 'http://localhost:3001/'.

Steps:
1. Enable Apache's proxy modules (mod_proxy and mod_proxy_http) if they are not already enabled.
2. Add reverse proxy directives to the acmecorp.test Apache virtual host configuration:
   - ProxyPass /app http://localhost:3001/
   - ProxyPassReverse /app http://localhost:3001/
3. Save the configuration and ensure Apache has been reloaded/restarted so the changes take effect.

You can accomplish this through the Virtualmin web interface (Server Configuration > Edit Proxy Website or Edit Directives) or Webmin's Apache module.
